title: Compliance onboarding milestone orchestration & driftguard for SOC2/ISO/SSO
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Build a milestone orchestration layer and a 'driftguard' circuit-breaker to prevent customer onboarding cutovers if required compliance evidence (SOC2/ISO artifacts, SSO/SAML config verification, audit log retention) is incomplete or regressed. This ticket scopes the product milestone definition, gating rules, communication playbook, and telemetry requirements. We will define per-milestone checkpoints, automated evidence verification hooks, and an escalation playbook for owners. The feature should integrate with console rollouts, evidence ingestion pipeline, SSO cutover windows, and the auditlog retention enforcement agent.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Define milestone schema and gating rules (evidence required, owner, SLA window) and publish in Confluence
A2: Implement a requirements-to-evidence mapping table and automated checks for 80% of critical evidence types (SSO config, auditlog retention policy, encryption keys)
A3: Console shows milestone status with last verification timestamp and failing reasons
A4: Onboarding pipeline stops and notifies owners when a gate is failed; runbook links in notification
A5: End-to-end test coverage for gate failure/showback, and a canary simulation for 2 tenants
A6: Security sign-off and documented rollback criteria
comments: 2025-01-15 - Ava Chen: Scoped initial problem statement after cross-org kickoff. Noted repeated late discoveries in customer onboarding due to missing auditlog retention docs. Proposing Milestone orchestration + automatic verifications rather than manual checklists.

2025-01-22 - Marco Ruiz: Completed stakeholder interviews (Security, Infra, Console, Legal). Key ask: ability to attach evidence links and a last-verified timestamp. Raised question about whether harness should enforce encryption key rotation windows.
2025-01-30 - Priya Nair (Security): Security spike scheduled to validate automated SSO metadata verification approach. Recommendation: signed metadata + test auth flow as proof of SSO readiness.
2025-02-04 - Eng lead (Diego Morales): Eng spike found two blockers: k8s RBAC for evidence ingestion lambda and KMS patch required for auditlog hashing. Blocking until ENG-1842 lands.

2025-02-10 - Marco Ruiz: Proposal for phased rollout: Phase 1 (milestone schema + console UI + manual verify hook), Phase 2 (automated evidence checks + notifications), Phase 3 (circuit-breaker enforcement on onboarding). Sending PRD to stakeholders: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ASSURANCE/Milestone+Orchestration
2025-02-10 - QA (Liam O'Connor): Will add canary test plan for two sandbox tenants and regression suite for console gating UI. Need feature flag toggle for enforcement.
decisions: D1: Milestone schema will include fields: id, title, owners, required_evidence_types, verification_interval, enforcement_level
D2: Enforcement levels: advisory (UI only), blocking (prevent onboarding), and audit-only (for reporting). Default for SOC2/ISO initial onboarding = advisory -> blocking after stable 2 cycles
D3: Evidence verification will be best-effort automated; when automation can't validate, we surface a manual evidence attachment flow with TTL for manual verification
D4: Use feature flag 'milestone-driftguard' scoped per-customer and per-cycle for staged rollouts
next_steps: N1: Finalize PRD edits and circulate to Legal and Security for sign-off (owner: Ava) by 2025-02-17
N2: Eng to unblock dependency ENG-1842 and estimate effort for automated checks (owner: Diego) by 2025-02-21
N3: Design to produce console mockups for milestone view + failed-gate toast (owner: Sienna Park) by 2025-02-20
N4: QA to prepare canary test plan and automation harness (owner: Liam) by 2025-02-24

progress_summary: Discovery complete. PRD drafted. Engineering spike revealed infra blockers (KMS + RBAC). Design mockups in progress. Security spike recommends metadata-signed SSO verification. Next: unblock infra dependencies and finish console UX for evidence surfacing.
